speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs' (MFA's) mission is to safeguard Singapore’s Independence and expand overseas opportunities for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to deepen engagement with regional and key powers for Singapore’s long-term security and prosperity; cultivate a wide network of international friends; play a constructive role in multilateral fora; and expand Singapore’s mindshare and value proposition on the international stage.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With China, our cooperation is deep, long-standing and substantive.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Besides building on the existing bilateral mechanisms and three Government-to-Government projects, we will pursue cooperation on a wide range of areas, including the Belt and Road Initiative.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With the United States (US), we will build on our long-standing relationship that is underpinned by robust defence and security cooperation, as well as deep economic linkages.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Relations with our immediate neighbours remain of utmost importance.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will also deepen people-to-people links through educational, cultural and youth exchanges.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With Indonesia, we will promote closer economic links, including through investments, skills training, tourism and the digital economy.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will explore new areas of cooperation with Indonesia’s regions.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Promoting free trade and regional economic integration remains an important part of MFA’s work.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: This year, the 3rd Singapore-Sub-Saharan Africa High-Level Ministerial Exchange Visit will focus on building partnerships in smart city development.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With South Asia, we will deepen economic engagement after the signing of the Sri Lanka-Singapore Free Trade Agreement in January 2018.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to deepen our economic links with Latin America, including through FTA negotiations with the Pacific Alliance and Mercosur.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will also maintain a consistent position in upholding international law and supporting the peaceful resolution of disputes.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to develop the Singapore Cooperation Programme (SCP) as a showcase of Singapore’s wide range of expertise, including good governance, aviation and port management, and liveable and smart cities.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The SCP's capacity-building programmes aim to reinforce Singapore’s relevance and role as a responsible member of the international community.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will improve the delivery of consular support to overseas Singaporeans through innovative technology and outreach initiatives.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will step up engagement of Singaporeans both at home and abroad to help support our diplomacy.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: This includes combating deliberate falsehoods from external parties that seek to influence Singapore’s domestic and foreign policy decisions.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will continue to expand our diplomatic, political and economic space, and work with other Ministries as part of a whole-of-Government effort to preserve and advance our interests in a fast-changing and unpredictable world.
